item.title: Govt. to crack down on tax-evading Christmas freebies
item.description: The government has decided that this year, tax inspectors will follow Santa Claus and assess the value each present delivered before imposing appropriate VAT and import duty on it. The inspectors will also measure the distance covered by Santa's sleigh and calculate the mileage charge payable. This is before visiting Santa's workshop and checking the elves' timesheets and wage slips before imposing the correct employer's NI and pension contributions.
